Atom Partner Python SDK Documentation

Installation

pip install atom-partner-sdk

Usage

from atom_partner.client import AtomPartnerClient

client = AtomPartnerClient('http://localhost:8200')
result = client.register_partner({
    'name': 'My Company',
    'email': 'contact@company.com',
    'org': 'Company Inc'
})

API Reference

  • register_partner(payload) - Register a new partner
  • get_partner(partner_id) - Get partner details
  • publish_package(package_data) - Publish package to marketplace
